title: Wire provider registry and refresh workers into server TOML
description: Add runtime TOML secret provider definitions, build and freeze concrete providers at startup, register legacy Infisical compatibility providers, run the HA refresh scheduler on every replica, and wipe/stop provider state during shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Server validates provider-specific non-secret configuration and typed auth references; configured providers and legacy Infisical sources refresh without manual wiring; scheduler starts after DEK/store readiness and stops before key wipe; invalid or unavailable provider bootstrap fails safely; multi-replica startup and shutdown tests pass.
close_reason: Added validated/redacted runtime TOML provider definitions; startup builds AWS, SPIFFE OpenBao X.509/JWT, typed-token 1Password, shared and legacy Infisical providers, freezes registry, and runs HA scheduler per replica. Shutdown drains scheduler and closes identity sources before key wipe. Full tests, vet, and focused race suites pass.

title: Run Kubernetes fleet end-to-end failure scenarios
description: Test a real multi-replica broker with SPIRE, relay workloads, PostgreSQL, representative providers, SVID rotation, pod disruption, provider outage, and stale-cache expiry.
acceptance_criteria: The suite proves identity attribution, no bypass, rotation without restart, bounded outage behavior, max-staleness fail-close, and no secret leakage in collected artifacts.

title: Verify PostgreSQL migration and refresh coordination under HA
description: Exercise concurrent pod startup, advisory migration locks, bootstrap ownership, refresh claiming, rolling upgrades, and connection loss against supported PostgreSQL versions.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-replica tests show one coherent schema and actor bootstrap, no duplicate refresh storm, safe reconnect, and documented version-skew constraints.

title: Add direct CLI secret imports
description: Resolve AWS, OpenBao, 1Password, env, file, and stdin sources in the CLI and import them over SPIFFE mTLS as independent local credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Imported values never enter TOML, argv, plan output, shell history guidance, or logs; source resolution errors are sanitized; resulting credentials have no live source link.

title: Implement idempotent apply and guarded prune
description: Apply plans through normal authorized APIs with revision checks, manager ownership, failure reporting, and explicit prune controls.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated apply makes no changes; default apply is additive; prune touches only same-manager resources and requires an extra flag for credential or identity deletion.
close_reason: Implemented owner-authorized deterministic plan/apply with reviewed SHA-256 guard, optimistic ownership revisions, additive defaults, guarded credential prune, SPIFFE-capable CLI, strict server revalidation, idempotency and compensated failure reporting.

title: Implement deterministic redacted plan engine
description: Compute creates, updates, adoptions, and optional owned deletions from desired TOML and current API state without resolving secret values.
acceptance_criteria: Equivalent inputs produce stable plans; sensitive fields show reference identity only; plans clearly mark conflicts, destructive operations, and prerequisites.
close_reason: Implemented deterministic redacted create/update/adopt/prune planning with ownership conflicts, ETag preconditions, dependency ordering, credential and parent-delete guards, safe reference descriptors, import-selector redaction, and full/race tests.

title: Add managed ownership and optimistic revisions
description: Persist manager ownership and resource revisions and expose redacted read APIs needed for safe reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Existing resources remain unmanaged until adopted; conflicting managers cannot silently take ownership; compare-and-swap failures return a useful non-secret conflict.
close_reason: Added managed-resource ownership metadata with atomic manager/revision compare-and-swap and safe conflicts, owner-only deterministic redacted fleet inventory with ETags, SQLite/Postgres migration and transfer support, plus concurrency, redaction, and authorization tests.

title: Define desired-state TOML schema and validation
description: Specify versioned TOML for vaults, services, SPIFFE-backed agents, grants, reference credentials, and import declarations, including multi-file merge rules.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas reject inline secret values, unknown keys, duplicate ownership, ambiguous merges, malformed SPIFFE IDs, and invalid provider references before any API mutation.
close_reason: Implemented strict versioned fleet TOML, deterministic multi-file merge, exact SPIFFE and role validation, provider-reference parsing without fetch, typed safe import declarations, ownership/conflict checks, cross-reference validation, and full/race test coverage.

title: Build HA-safe refresh scheduler and encrypted cache
description: Refresh reference credentials with jitter, exponential backoff, advisory or claimed work coordination, atomic cache updates, and max_staleness enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Replicas do not stampede providers; successful versions update once; last-known-good values work only within policy; stale or never-fetched credentials fail closed.
close_reason: Implemented HA-safe database leasing, atomic encrypted cache refresh completion, bounded stale-cache enforcement, jittered backoff, lost-claim handling, and a continuous scheduler; full tests, vet, and focused race suites pass.

title: Define provider registry and typed secret references
description: Create a SecretProvider interface and strict provider-specific reference parsing that returns bytes plus opaque version metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Providers are selected by configured name, references are validated before persistence, values are wipeable byte slices, and no executable or inline resolver exists on the server.
close_reason: Added frozen configured-name provider registry, provider-specific typed reference contract, validation-before-persistence boundary, wipeable owned result bytes with opaque versions, server-side executable/inline resolver rejection, sanitized errors, and concurrency tests.

title: Model secret sources per credential
description: Add per-credential source kind, provider name, opaque reference, mode, refresh policy, provider version, health, and cache timestamps with migration from vault-wide stores.
acceptance_criteria: A vault may mix source kinds; source metadata has no values; current built-in and Infisical data migrate without losing encrypted cache or service bindings.
close_reason: Added per-credential reference metadata and encrypted cache timestamps, mixed local/provider source CRUD, legacy Infisical backfill and compatibility lifecycle, direct-import detachment, SQLite/Postgres migration copy, and migration/redaction tests.

title: Add explicit recovery CLI and audit trail
description: Provide a recovery command that names the recovery provider, unwraps the DEK, establishes a new primary wrapping, and records non-secret audit metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery requires explicit operator intent and SPIFFE owner authorization, never runs automatically, verifies the new primary before success, and has a rehearsable runbook.
close_reason: Added explicit SPIFFE-owner-authorized age recovery CLI, atomic provider promotion plus secret-free audit history, private identity handling, migration preservation, invariant tests, and rehearsable Kubernetes runbook.

title: Implement atomic wrapper rotation and legacy migration
description: Add a verified add-before-retire rotation workflow and migrate password-wrapped or plaintext legacy DEKs to a configured primary wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted rotations retain at least one usable wrapping; all replicas converge; plaintext DEK columns are cleared only after verified provider unwrap.
close_reason: Implemented verified add-before-retire wrapper promotion, legacy plaintext migration, startup rotation, fail-closed provider handling, and replica convergence tests.

title: Add KeyWrapper interface and multiple DEK wrappings
description: Define provider-neutral wrap, unwrap, and identity metadata; migrate master_key to versioned wrapping rows while retaining a safe compatibility path.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple verified wrappings can coexist; provider metadata contains no secret; migrations are transactional and readable by rolling-version tests.
close_reason: Added provider-neutral KeyWrapper identity/binding/wrap/unwrap contract with immediate unwrap verification and wiping, plus transactional versioned DEK wrapping rows supporting one primary and multiple active/recovery ciphertexts while preserving the rolling-version legacy master_key record.

title: Connect relay to central proxy over SPIFFE mTLS
description: Use the relay SVID to establish and maintain mutually authenticated connections to the remote proxy and let the server attribute traffic directly to the SPIFFE-backed agent actor.
acceptance_criteria: No durable token is sent or exposed; remote identity verification is SPIFFE-aware; reconnect and certificate rotation preserve bounded in-flight behavior.
close_reason: Connected relay central dials through rotating SPIFFE mTLS callbacks with explicit broker trust-domain verification, exact server-side agent authorization, generic local failure responses, and tests proving SVID rotation, no bearer injection, and untrusted-broker rejection.

title: Implement loopback HTTP proxy relay
description: Build a relay that accepts CONNECT and absolute-form proxy requests only on loopback and streams them without interpreting or logging request bodies or credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Standard HTTP clients can use the relay; backpressure, cancellation, half-close, WebSocket, body limits, and graceful shutdown are covered by tests.
close_reason: Implemented an explicit-loopback, byte-streaming proxy relay with CONNECT and HTTP absolute-form gating, injectable central dial transport, graceful/forced shutdown, and race-tested coverage for streaming, body-limit propagation, half-close, WebSocket, cancellation, and invalid ingress.

title: Add SPIFFE auth mode and one-time owner bootstrap
description: Implement legacy, hybrid, and spiffe auth modes. In SPIFFE mode seed configured exact owner IDs only when no owner actor exists and disable password, invite, reset, and durable-token routes.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent first startup creates one consistent owner set; later config changes cannot silently grant ownership; SPIFFE-only mode exposes no working password or legacy-token path.
close_reason: Added legacy/hybrid/SPIFFE auth modes, live SPIRE listener wiring, transactional one-time SPIFFE owner bootstrap, SPIFFE-only route/token shutdown, and fleet Kubernetes configuration

title: Integrate SPIRE Workload API certificate sources
description: Use go-spiffe certificate and bundle sources for server and CLI identities with cancellation, readiness, and rotation support.
acceptance_criteria: Components obtain X.509-SVIDs from a configurable socket, rotate without restart, expose no private key material, and become unready when no valid SVID is available.
close_reason: Added cancellable SPIRE Workload API X509 source with live TLS callbacks, strict Unix socket validation, rotation signaling, readiness/expiry checks and no key-material accessors

title: Authenticate API and proxy listeners with SPIFFE mTLS
description: Add SPIFFE-aware TLS listeners and middleware that validates bundles, permitted trust domains, and exact peer IDs before mapping to an agent actor.
acceptance_criteria: Valid peers receive their existing actor context; unknown IDs, wrong trust domains, missing certificates, and spoofed headers fail before authorization; rotation works on live connections.
close_reason: Added rotating TLS API/proxy listeners, exact active-agent SPIFFE authorization, request actor mapping, proxy vault-scope resolution, and downgrade/spoof/rotation tests

title: Persist unique SPIFFE IDs on agent actors
description: Add nullable unique agents.spiffe_id migrations for SQLite and PostgreSQL, store lookups, lifecycle validation, and API wire types.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations preserve existing agents; duplicate or malformed IDs are rejected; exact-ID lookup is indexed; actor grants and audit behavior remain unchanged.
close_reason: Added nullable unique exact SPIFFE IDs to agent actors, migrations/data copy, lookup/update APIs, CLI creation and validation tests

title: Implement typed secret references and redaction
description: Parse env:// and file:// references for sensitive runtime settings without permitting inline secrets, commands, or traversal surprises. Centralize redacted formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive fields cannot be configured as TOML literals; reference resolution is bounded and tested; inspect, logs, and returned errors never contain resolved values.
close_reason: Implemented bounded env:// and file:// secret references with redacted values and leak-resistant tests

title: Define versioned runtime TOML schema and precedence
description: Create typed server and CLI configuration structures, file discovery, strict TOML decoding, defaults, and CLI > environment > TOML precedence.
acceptance_criteria: Table-driven tests cover every field, source precedence, missing files, schema versions, unknown keys, invalid combinations, and deterministic error messages.
close_reason: Implemented versioned strict TOML loading, discovery, defaults, validation, source attribution, and full precedence tests.

title: Declarative fleet reconciliation and CLI imports
description: Add versioned desired-state TOML plus plan/apply workflows for vaults, services, SPIFFE-backed agents, grants, and credential sources. Support direct CLI imports from provider, environment, file, and stdin resolvers.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated apply is idempotent; plan is fully redacted; concurrent changes use revisions; prune affects only manager-owned resources and requires extra confirmation for credentials or identities; imports never place values in TOML or argv.

title: Per-credential external secret providers
description: Refactor vault-wide external stores into per-credential sources supporting live references and encrypted last-known-good caches. Add AWS Secrets Manager, OpenBao KV v2, 1Password Connect, and compatibility for Infisical.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: One vault can safely mix local, AWS, OpenBao, 1Password, and Infisical credentials; refresh is HA-safe; stale values fail closed at max_staleness; provider values never appear in metadata, logs, plans, or errors.
close_reason: Per-credential external provider framework is implemented end to end: source metadata and encrypted LKG caches, HA refresh claims, AWS/OpenBao/1Password/Infisical providers, runtime TOML wiring, cancellation/redaction/staleness/mixed-vault tests, and server lifecycle integration all pass.

title: Pluggable DEK wrapping and explicit recovery
description: Replace the single password/plaintext DEK record with multiple provider-backed wrappings using AWS KMS, OpenBao Transit, and an explicit local age X25519 recovery recipient.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL never contains a plaintext DEK; replicas unwrap through the configured primary provider; rotations are atomic; provider outages do not trigger automatic recovery; an operator can complete and audit a documented explicit recovery drill.
close_reason: All seven DEK wrapping, KMS, Transit, offline recovery, atomic rotation, audited recovery, and fault-invariant items are complete and verified.

title: Kubernetes workload relay and sidecar
description: Build the local proxy relay that isolates the SPIRE Workload API socket and SVID private key from untrusted agent containers while forwarding standard proxy traffic to Agent Vault over mTLS.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: An arbitrary agent using a loopback HTTP proxy can reach allowed services through the central broker; only the relay holds SPIFFE material; rotation, reconnect, shutdown, and network-policy tests pass in Kubernetes.

title: SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity and authorization
description: Bind exact SPIFFE IDs to the existing agent actor model, obtain rotating X.509-SVIDs from SPIRE, authenticate API and proxy traffic with mTLS, and support a SPIFFE-only deployment mode with one-time owner bootstrap.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: An in-cluster workload and operator CLI authenticate using rotating SVIDs without passwords or durable Agent Vault tokens; exact SPIFFE IDs map to existing RBAC and audit actors; invalid identities and disabled legacy routes fail closed.
close_reason: Completed SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity authorization with exact actor mapping, rotating X.509-SVIDs, mTLS API/proxy transport, SPIFFE-only bootstrap, in-cluster CLI support, and downgrade-resistant tests.

title: Fleet runtime configuration in TOML
description: Add strict, versioned TOML runtime configuration for server and CLI startup with deterministic precedence, typed secret references, validation, and redacted inspection. Preserve current flags and environment variables as compatibility inputs.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: A production server can be fully configured from TOML plus external secret references; CLI flags override environment, environment overrides TOML, unknown keys fail validation, and no resolved secret is emitted by inspect, errors, or logs.
close_reason: All five configuration children complete with passing tests, validation/inspection CLI, compatibility runtime integration and fleet documentation

title: Stage hybrid-to-SPIFFE-only fleet migration
description: Document and automate inventory, SPIFFE binding, hybrid verification, durable-token revocation, password-route disablement, and rollback checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: A seeded legacy deployment migrates without losing grants or service access; final SPIFFE-only tests show all password and durable-token paths disabled.

title: Prove backup, restore, and explicit key recovery
description: Create a runbook and automated drill that backs up Postgres, restores to a clean cluster, unwraps with the primary provider, and separately exercises offline recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Restored vaults, sources, grants, audit data, CA state, and wrappings are usable; recovery requires explicit action; RPO and RTO observations are recorded.

title: Harden PostgreSQL TLS, roles, pools, and diagnostics
description: Require configurable TLS verification, document least-privilege roles, validate pool bounds and timeouts, and sanitize database connection errors.
acceptance_criteria: Production example uses verify-full or equivalent, no admin database role, bounded aggregate connections across replicas, and no DSN credentials in logs or health responses.

title: Separate startup, readiness, and liveness checks
description: Report process health separately from PostgreSQL migration, SVID acquisition, DEK unwrap, and mandatory provider readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Kubernetes never routes traffic before secure initialization, transient provider failure does not cause destructive restart loops, and deadlocked processes fail liveness.

title: Package the broker, relay, and reconciler for Kubernetes
description: Provide production Helm or Kustomize assets for multiple broker replicas, relay sidecars, SPIRE CSI sockets, Services, service accounts, disruption budgets, and NetworkPolicies.
acceptance_criteria: A clean namespace deploys from documented values without inline secrets and passes security-context and manifest validation checks.

title: Publish fleet manifest examples and schema reference
description: Document plan, apply, ownership, adoption, prune, imports, provider references, and GitOps execution using an in-cluster SPIFFE operator.
acceptance_criteria: Examples validate in CI and include safe multi-environment composition, reviewable redacted plans, and rollback guidance.

title: Test reconciliation concurrency and idempotency
description: Run integration tests for repeated apply, competing managers, stale revisions, partial API failure, guarded prune, imports, and redaction.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove deterministic convergence without secret leakage and leave a recoverable, accurately reported state after every injected failure.

title: Test provider redaction, staleness, and mixed vaults
description: Add contract tests shared by every provider plus multi-provider integration tests, provider outage tests, and value-leak scans over logs, plans, API responses, and database metadata.
acceptance_criteria: All providers satisfy common cancellation, versioning, redaction, and staleness contracts; mixed vault proxy resolution remains deterministic and secure.
close_reason: Added shared cancellation conformance across all concrete providers and fixed cancellation propagation; added real-provider mixed-vault integration covering encrypted caches, native-version no-op refresh, outage LKG bounds, stale fail-closed state, and secret/token/upstream-error leak scans. Full tests, vet, and focused race suites pass.

title: Adapt Infisical to the provider framework
description: Preserve existing Infisical static and dynamic-secret behavior behind the common provider and refresh abstractions while removing the one-store-per-vault restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Infisical configurations migrate and continue refreshing; dynamic leases retain lifecycle semantics; mixed-provider vaults work without regression.
close_reason: Adapted static Infisical secrets to the per-credential provider contract with exact retrieval, native ID/version metadata, sanitized SDK failures, shared project/environment/path references, and legacy provider registration. Existing dynamic lease resolver remains memory-only with renew/revoke lifecycle; full tests, vet, and race tests pass.

title: Add 1Password Connect provider
description: Resolve vault, item, section, and field references through 1Password Connect with its access token read from a typed file or environment reference.
acceptance_criteria: Connect tokens are never accepted inline or logged; field selection and version changes are tested; unavailable Connect uses the common staleness policy.
close_reason: Added 1Password Connect provider with typed env/file-only token references, per-request token rotation and wiping, strict vault/item/section/field references, unambiguous field resolution, item-version tracking, and sanitized availability errors. Full tests, vet, and provider race tests pass.

title: Add AWS Secrets Manager provider
description: Resolve secret ARNs or names, JSON fields, stages, and pinned versions through the AWS SDK default credential chain.
acceptance_criteria: Binary and string secrets are handled safely; EKS workload identity works without static keys; missing fields and permissions produce sanitized health state.
close_reason: Added AWS SDK default-chain provider with EKS Pod Identity/IRSA support, strict ARN/name references, JSON field and version selectors, binary-safe results, buffer wiping, and sanitized AWS error mapping; full tests, vet, and provider race tests pass.

title: Add OpenBao KV v2 provider
description: Resolve mount, path, field, and version references from OpenBao KV v2 using rotating SPIFFE X.509 or JWT authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Version metadata and deletion states are respected; authentication rotates; values and OpenBao tokens never appear in Agent Vault persistence or diagnostics.
close_reason: Added OpenBao KV v2 provider with strict mount/path/field/version references, deletion-state enforcement, redacted errors and wiped tokens; extracted shared rotating SPIFFE X.509 auth and added per-call audience-bound JWT-SVID auth. Full tests, vet, and focused race suites pass.

title: Test key-provider outage, rotation, and recovery invariants
description: Add fault-injection and multi-replica tests covering unavailable KMS or Transit, stale credentials, partial rotations, concurrent startup, and offline recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove a database-only compromise exposes no DEK, outages do not downgrade protection, and every successful rotation or recovery leaves a decryptable primary wrapping.
close_reason: Added repeated fault-injection fleet invariants for database-only compromise, KMS and Transit outages, failed rotation, concurrent replica convergence, explicit offline recovery, and decryptable final primary; fixed a selected-primary unwrap race.

title: Implement offline age X25519 recovery wrapping
description: Encrypt a recovery copy of the DEK to a configured age X25519 recipient and accept the private identity only through an explicit recovery operation.
acceptance_criteria: Normal startup never reads or requests the recovery identity; no plaintext fallback exists; incorrect identities fail without modifying primary wrapping state.
close_reason: Implemented recovery-only age X25519 wrapping with public-recipient-only TOML, instance-bound encrypted envelopes, an explicit private-identity Recover entrypoint, no generic/startup unwrap path, plaintext wiping, and tests for wrong identity/binding and state immutability.

title: Implement AWS KMS DEK wrapper
description: Wrap and unwrap the DEK with AWS KMS using the default AWS credential chain and an instance-bound encryption context.
acceptance_criteria: KMS key ARN and region are configurable; encryption-context mismatch fails; SDK errors are sanitized; EKS Pod Identity or IRSA works without static AWS keys.
close_reason: Implemented typed AWS KMS wrapper configuration and SDK default-chain client for EKS Pod Identity/IRSA, exact key ARN and region validation, instance-bound encryption context, symmetric encrypt/decrypt, mismatch failure, immediate wrap verification, and sanitized provider errors.

title: Implement OpenBao Transit DEK wrapper
description: Wrap and unwrap the DEK through a configured OpenBao Transit key using SPIFFE X.509 or JWT authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Transit ciphertext and key version are persisted; authentication rotates with the SVID; revoked access and malformed responses fail closed without leaking details.
close_reason: Implemented OpenBao Transit wrapper with versioned ciphertext parsing, instance associated-data binding, ephemeral per-operation certificate-auth tokens over rotating SPIFFE mTLS, typed TOML configuration, and fail-closed sanitized tests for revocation and malformed responses.

title: Test relay rotation, reconnect, and disruption behavior
description: Create integration tests for SVID rotation, SPIRE restart, broker rolling restart, connection drain, proxy load, and upstream timeout.
acceptance_criteria: No request is attributed to the wrong identity; failures are bounded and recover automatically when trust is restored; tests detect goroutine and connection leaks.
close_reason: Added repeated race-tested disruption coverage for SVID rotation/outage recovery, broker rolling restart, concurrent proxy load, connection drain/leak detection, and bounded connect timeout while preserving exact SPIFFE attribution.

title: Define relay network and pod security policy
description: Add NetworkPolicy and deployment guidance that blocks agent-container access to SPIRE and direct broker egress while allowing relay-to-broker and intended upstream paths.
acceptance_criteria: The reference policy is validated in Kubernetes and demonstrates that bypass attempts from the untrusted container fail while normal relay traffic succeeds.

title: Package relay as a Kubernetes sidecar
description: Provide a minimal relay image, security context, resource settings, Workload API socket mount, readiness probe, and example pod injection templates.
acceptance_criteria: An example workload deploys with the socket mounted only into the relay, a read-only filesystem, non-root execution, and working loopback proxy variables.
close_reason: Added a minimal non-root relay image and validated Kubernetes sidecar example with loopback proxy/CA environment, read-only filesystems, dropped capabilities, bounded resources, readiness probe, and SPIRE socket mounted only in the relay.

title: Add relay and run command lifecycle integration
description: Add a relay subcommand and integrate it with vault run so child processes receive only loopback proxy and CA settings while sensitive relay state stays in the parent.
acceptance_criteria: Child environments contain no SVID key, Workload API socket, provider credential, KMS permission, or Agent Vault bearer token; exit codes and signals propagate correctly.
close_reason: Added TOML/env relay configuration, standalone relay command, and SPIFFE-aware vault run supervision that keeps Workload API and provider credentials in the parent, supplies only loopback proxy/CA settings to children, propagates signals/exit codes, and drains cleanly.

title: Exercise SPIFFE authorization and downgrade resistance
description: Add unit, integration, and negative tests for identity parsing, bundle validation, auth-mode routing, bootstrap races, role enforcement, and audit attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove exact matching, trust-domain isolation, rotation, revocation behavior, and that token or password downgrade attempts fail in SPIFFE-only mode.
close_reason: Added end-to-end SPIFFE listener and proxy tests covering exact identity, trust isolation, role enforcement, rotation, reused-connection revocation, downgrade resistance, and audit attribution.

title: Use SPIFFE mTLS for in-cluster CLI operations
description: Create an HTTP transport for CLI commands that reads rotating SVIDs from the Workload API and removes the need for persisted login sessions in SPIFFE mode.
acceptance_criteria: The operator CLI performs all authorized control-plane operations with its SVID, rotates transparently, stores no bearer token, and gives actionable sanitized socket or trust errors.
close_reason: Added client-only TOML loading, rotating SPIRE mTLS CLI transport, ephemeral no-token sessions, no password fallback, and actionable socket/trust errors

title: Document configuration schema and compatibility migration
description: Publish a complete reference and Kubernetes-oriented examples, plus tests that detect schema/documentation drift.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported key, precedence rule, secret-reference form, and legacy mapping is documented and examples pass automated validation.
close_reason: Published complete TOML reference and Kubernetes Kustomize example with automated schema, environment mapping, YAML and example validation

title: Refactor server startup around resolved configuration
description: Replace scattered flag and os.Getenv reads in server startup, storage, SMTP, rate limits, logging, and limits with one validated resolved configuration while preserving compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Existing flag and environment behavior remains covered by tests, startup consumes one immutable configuration object, and secret environment variables are cleared after resolution where applicable.
close_reason: Server startup now consumes one validated resolved config; storage, SMTP, rate limits, retention, network limits, telemetry and detached mode preserve compatibility with tested secret env scrubbing

title: Add config validate and redacted inspect commands
description: Provide commands that validate runtime TOML and show source-aware effective configuration without starting a server.
acceptance_criteria: Validation is usable in CI; inspect identifies whether values came from flag, environment, TOML, or default while always redacting sensitive values.
close_reason: Added CI-friendly config validate and text/JSON redacted inspect commands with per-field source attribution

title: PostgreSQL HA and Kubernetes production rollout
description: Harden shared PostgreSQL operation, probes, refresh coordination, Kubernetes packaging, backup and recovery, and the staged migration from legacy authentication to SPIFFE-only fleet operation.
design: See docs/design/fleet-kubernetes-spiffe.md for the accepted architecture and security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: A multi-replica Kubernetes deployment survives pod and provider disruption, rotates SVIDs, coordinates migrations and refreshes, restores from backup, completes the KMS recovery drill, and disables legacy auth after a documented hybrid migration.

title: Add fleet-safe observability and operational alerts
description: Expose non-secret metrics and structured events for SVID health, unwrap status, provider freshness, refresh failures, reconcile conflicts, Postgres health, and relay connectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards and alert examples identify impending staleness and identity failures without labels or messages containing secret values, tokens, DSNs, or provider payloads.
